phrases.english: What time is it, please?
I’m running late, sorry.
It’s a quarter past eight.
It’s almost ten o’clock.
We’ll meet at seven sharp.
Where is the checkout counter, please?
How much is this, exactly?
Can I try this on, please?
I only want one piece.
Do you have it in small size?
It’s sunny today, enjoy the day.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟକିରଣ ଅଛି, ଦିନଟା ଉପଭୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji surjya-kiran achhi, dinata upabhoga karantu.

phrases.english: Clouds are gathering, it might rain.
The rain is light, don’t worry.
It’s raining now, take an umbrella.
The wind is strong today, be careful.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ପବନ ବେଶ ଜୋର, ସାବଧାନ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji paban besh jor, sabadhaana ruhantu.

phrases.english: I practice daily, slowly, and keep going.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରେ, ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ, ଆଉ ଚାଲୁ ରଖେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ pratidina abhyaasa kare, dhire dhire, aau chalu rakhe.

phrases.english: Today, I will try again, no worries.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି, ମୁଁ ପୁନି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି, ଚିନ୍ତା ନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji, muṁ puni chesta karibi, chinta nahin.

phrases.english: I’m improving, one small step at a time.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଉନ୍ନତି କରୁଛି, ପ୍ରତିଥର ଗୋଟିଏ ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ unnati karuchhi, pratyekathara gotie chhota padakhepare.

phrases.english: Keep breathing, and speak with confidence.
Mistakes help me learn, so relax.
phrases.odia: ଭୁଲମାନେ ମୋତେ ଶିଖାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଆରାମ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Bhulumane mote shikha‘e, tena au aaram kar.

phrases.english: A cow is eating grass, slowly.
The cat wants to come inside, please.
Look at the dog, it’s wagging.
That bird is singing outside, loudly.
The frog is jumping near the pond.
I love this song, it’s so catchy.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହି ଗୀତଟାକୁ ଭଲପାଏ, ବହୁତ ଆକର୍ଷକ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu ehi geetataaku bhala paaye, bahuta aakarshaka.

phrases.english: Play it again, please.
That rhythm feels amazing.
Turn the volume up a little.
Turn it down, it’s too loud.
I need a smaller EMI this month.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଏହି ମାସରେ ଛୋଟ EMI ଦରକାର।
phrases.transliteration: Mo ei masare chhota EMI darkar.

phrases.english: Please check my bank balance now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ମୋ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଲାନ୍ସ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari bartaman mo bank balance janch kar.

phrases.english: Did my salary get credited today, please?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ଦରମା ଆସିଛି କି, ଦୟାକରି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo dhrama asichi ki, dayakari?

phrases.english: I want to open a savings account.
The ATM declined my card again.
phrases.odia: ଏହି ATM ଆଉଥରେ ମୋ କାର୍ଡ ଅସ୍ଵୀକାର କରିଲା।
phrases.transliteration: Ei ATM autehare mo card aswikar karila.

phrases.english: I love you, my heart.
You make me feel safe, always.
I miss you, please come back.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ ମିସ୍ କରୁଛି, ଦୟାକରି ଫେରିଆସ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ tumaku mis karuchi, dayakari feriās.

phrases.english: Stay with me, just tonight.
Your smile is my favorite thing.
Thank you for your kindness, really.
I truly appreciate your help today.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଖୁବ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji apananka sahajya paain mu sebu aabari.

phrases.english: Thanks, you made my day better.
phrases.odia: ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ଆପଣ ମୋ ଦିନଟା ଭଲ କରିଦେଲେ।
phrases.transliteration: Dhanyabad, apana mo dinata bhala karidele.

phrases.english: I’m grateful for everything you do.
phrases.odia: ଆପଣ କରୁଥିବା ସବୁକିଛି ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Apana karuthiba sabukichhi paain mu aabari.

phrases.english: Thank you for listening to me.
I will improve, day by day,
Stay calm, even when things change,
I can learn from every mistake,
Small steps, big progress, you know,
Today, I choose to do my best,
I can face this, step by step.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହାକୁ ସାମ୍ନା କରିପାରିବି, ପଦେ ପଦେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha ku saamna karipaaribi, pade pade.

phrases.english: Take a deep breath, you’ve got this.
Don’t be afraid, speak up now.
I’ll try again, even if it’s hard.
phrases.odia: କଠିନ ହେଲେମଧ୍ୟ, ମୁଁ ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି।
phrases.transliteration: Kathiina helamadhya, mu puni chesta karibi.

phrases.english: Be brave, small steps still count.
phrases.odia: ସାହସ କର, ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗଣିଯାଏ।
phrases.transliteration: Sahasa kara, chhota padakhepa madhya gani jaae.
